name: audit2e url format scheme and parse query object
source: import * as url from "node:url"; function main(): void { console.log(url.format({ protocol: "https", hostname: "a.com", pathname: "/x", query: { a: "1" } })); console.log(url.format({ protocol: "http:", host: "a.com:80", search: "?q=1", hash: "#h" })); console.log(url.format({ protocol: "https:", hostname: "a.com", pathname: "x", search: "q=1", hash: "h" })); const r = url.parse("/p/a?x=1&x=2&y=3", true); console.log(r.query, r.pathname, r.search, r.host); console.log(url.parse("/p?x=1").query, url.parse("/p", true).query); console.log(url.resolve("http://a.com/b/c", "../d"), url.domainToASCII("münchen.de"), url.domainToUnicode("xn--mnchen-3ya.de")); }
